messages:
maya: quick one — did a pass on the routing policies editor preview. noticed a few interaction & copy pain points when reordering rules and when the sim shows conflicts. attaching mental notes below. pls react with :eyes: if you want to pair on this this week

sam: yes please. can you list the main UX things? i skimmed earlier but happy to help prioritize

maya: main spots: 1) drag handle affordance is too small when the list is dense — folks keep trying to drag the whole card not the handle. 2) validation toast text when a rule has an invalid target is vague: currently says `Rule failed` — needs actionable fix. 3) preview sim toggles reset after a rule reorder which is surprising. 4) keyboard focus order is inconsistent when moving rules up/down (a11y)

jorge: re: 1 — what if we expand hit target to full left gutter on hover, show a subtle move cursor and keep handle visible always in compact mode? similar to file lists in IDEs.

maya: exactly. mock: show gutter highlight + 24px pad for handle. keeps density but adds discoverability.

emma: on 2 (validation copy) — i recommend something like: `Invalid destination: the target service {{service}} is unreachable. Update the target or disable this rule.` shorter: `Destination unreachable — update target` Thoughts?

sam: +1 for actionable copy. Less ambiguous than `Rule failed`. maybe include a quick link to the rule inspector: `Destination unreachable — open rule to fix` (link icon)

kyle: about the sim reset — is that because preview state is keyed by rule id position, so when order changes we recreate the sim? if so we might persist sim filters/traffic % in the route config rather than ephemeral UI state.

maya: yep, looks like sim state keyed to index. fix options: a) persist sim settings to local route state so reorders keep them, b) show a small animation/notice `Preview settings preserved` when we successfully map settings to new positions, c) keep current behavior but show a confirmation toast so it doesn't feel like a bug. preference: (a) or (b).

jorge: for keyboard reorder, we should ensure after moving an item up/down focus stays on the moved item. current dev build jumps focus to top of list. a11y-bot reported it.

a11y-bot: automated-a11y-scan: keyboard navigation fails 2 checks — focusable element mismatch, missing live-region for reorder announcements. Recommend: implement `aria-live` on list container and maintain tabindex on moved item.

emma: on error microcopy — also consider severity labeling in the inspector: `warning` vs `blocking` vs `info`. right now everything is `error` which causes alarm. maybe make unreachable destination a `warning` with suggested action, and only block if the rule syntactically invalid.

sam: UX nit: the priority drag order uses a ghost preview that covers the snippet text while dragging — makes it hard to verify which rules you're moving. can we render the ghost as semi-transparent and keep snippet visible?

maya: good call. reduce ghost opacity to 0.65 and add a thin border. also keep a small index label (eg `#3`) on each item during drag so you can see new rank at glance.

jorge: validation flow idea: when a rule is invalid, we add an inline pill `Needs attention` with a chevron to expand the inspector. clicking that opens the rule in a side panel with suggested fixes (auto-fill where possible). reduces context switching.

maya: mock copy for the inline pill: `Needs attention — destination unreachable` and on hover show `Open inspector to update target`

sam: small copy tweak for preview simulation: the toggle currently says `Simulate` — suggest `Run preview` which maps better to action and analytics naming (`run_preview`).

emma: +1 to `Run preview`. also add a small stopwatch microcopy for long sims: `Running preview — results are approximate` and a cancel button.

kyle: dev implication note: preserving sim settings across reorder will need stable rule ids (we have them) and a mapping step in the frontend. low risk but will need a tiny migration/ts guard. estimate: 2–3 dev days.

maya: next steps: 1) sam & jorge — pair on drag affordance mock and ghost treatment. 2) emma — land the updated microcopy + severity scale. 3) kyle — scope sim-state persistence PR. 4) a11y-bot tags + checklist: live region + focus retention.

sam: i'll take (1) — will drop a Figma frame by EOD today :+1:

emma: i'll put copy in the UX doc and run it by legal if we mention service names.

jorge: i'll add a11y considerations to the design handoff and include keyboard interaction notes.

maya: awesome, thanks team. tagging @kyle for timeline — can we aim for a small iteration in next sprint?

kyle: yup — target to ship the small UX polish + copy in sprint (no backend) — if sim persistence slips we can push it to follow-up.

sam: fyi i'm also adding a short e2e test: drag reorder + run preview to catch regressions

maya: perfect. i'll update the ticket with the chosen copy + attach the figma frames when ready. :sparkles:

a11y-bot: added checklist item to ticket #UI-412: `aria-live`, `focus retention`, keyboard reorder announcement

sam: :eyes:
